mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing the discount rate applied to future corporate earnings and increasing the present value of equity cash flows, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances despite a declining FEDFUNDS trend, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll growth above 200k per month signals strong labor market demand, which supports consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances despite PAYEMS > 200.0, or the Rank IC over any 2-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in residential construction starts and real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) indicates strong underlying demand for goods and services, which increases corporate revenue visibility and reduces earnings risk, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS rise, or the interaction term IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production below 108.0 (index 2017=100) signals weakening manufacturing output, which reduces inflationary pressure and increases the likelihood of future monetary easing, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 108.0, or the Rank IC over any 2-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% per annum signals a tightening monetary cycle, increasing the discount rate on equity cash flows and reducing the present value of future earnings, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances despite FEDFUNDS > 4.5, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is above -0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) and GDP growth (GDPC1) indicates a weakening demand environment, which increases the risk of corporate earnings contraction and triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when both RSAFS and GDPC1 decline, or the interaction term IC is above -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the unemployment rate above 4.0% and a decline in non-farm payroll growth below 100k signals a labor market slowdown, which reduces consumer spending and corporate revenue expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances despite UNRATE > 4.0 and PAYEMS < 100.0, or the interaction term IC is above -0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production below 108.0 combined with a rise in the unemployment rate above 4.0% indicates a supply-side shock coupled with weak labor demand, increasing economic uncertainty and reducing equity risk appetite, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when both INDPRO < 108.0 and UNRATE > 4.0, or the interaction term IC is above -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
